Message:
As haze took over
my consciousness,
a single memory
drifted into my mind.

The memory of the moment
I broke my vow to Fortina...

With a sword raised
above my head,
she held her arms
wide open towards me,
calling out my name.

I cast my frigid glare
down at her,
before my sword
tore right through her...
and our bond.

Even after going through that,
Fortina refused to give up on me,

crawling on the ice-cold floor
as she called out my name
again and again...

I didn’t even
so much as turn around...
and the pain I caused Fortina
was deeper than
any sword could inflict.

If only my heart were stronger...
Strong enough so that
no darkness could’ve ever
taken root inside...
then I...!

That’s right.
I will never make her
suffer in pain ever again...!

I wrench myself
back to my senses,
and rise to my feet.

To make my way
home to her...!
